subject: brown cow
title: A Pet Cow Uses a Broom, and She Picks Which End on Purpose

scenes.text: A cow in Austria uses a tool. And she knows which end to hold.
Veronika, a pet brown cow, picks up a broom with her tongue and grips it in her teeth.
On her tough back, she scratches with the stiff bristles.
On her soft belly and udder, she switches to the smooth handle instead.
Scientists first thought she had grabbed the wrong end. Then she kept doing it.
In 2026 she became the first documented cow to use a tool. After about ten thousand years of farming cattle.

description:
Veronika, a pet Brown Swiss cow in Austria, uses a broom to scratch herself, choosing the bristles for her tough back and the smooth handle for her softer belly and udder.
Researchers from the University of Veterinary Medicine Vienna described it in Current Biology in January 2026 as the first documented flexible tool use by a cow.
Which farm animal do you think is smartest?
first_comment: Veronika is about 13 years old and lives as a pet, not on a working farm. Could that be why she figured it out?
